info.name: Personal AI Productivity Companion Backend
info.description:
Postman collection for the Personal AI Productivity Companion backend API.

Workflow:
1. Register or Login to get an accessToken
2. Create Goals → save goalId
3. Create Tasks (optionally linked to a goal) → save taskId
4. Chat with Companion → save conversationId
5. Create Check-ins

Authenticated requests use Bearer {{accessToken}}.
Refresh token is stored in an httpOnly cookie by the backend.
